dcterms:creator: Simone Teufel
dcterms:description: The Argumentative Zoning corpus consists of 80 AZ-annotated conference articles in the research area of computational linguistics, hosted in the academic archive of Cmplg arXiv. The set of AZ tags include AIM (purpose), BAS (basis), BKG (background), CTR (contrast), OTH (previous work), OWN (own method and results), TXT (textual references).
dcterms:title: Argumentative Zoning Corpus

dcterms:description: The Citeseerx corpus is a collection of approximately four million computer science abstracts used for extracting sentential patterns to assist learners in academic writing.
dcterms:title: Citeseerx Corpus
